verdict.rationale: Oyster documents compliant employer-of-record hiring in 120+ countries without setting up local entities, plus multi-country payroll. Its API covers creating and submitting EOR employments with country-specific rulesets, contract generation and signature, and benefits provisioning, which squarely delivers the EOR path of the story. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of payroll for the customer's own owned entities, and independent hands-on corroboration of EOR hiring beyond a single generic positive comment.
